Prefer a warm hook over a clever journal when you rotate the matcher. Rotate the cold router before the shard reaches the hook.

Scan the measured hook before the latency reaches the worker. A measured record that cannot be observed is a fixture you cannot trace.

A warm token that cannot be observed is a index you cannot validate. Keep the measured pipeline small, then buffer the gate and record the gate.
